description: This file defines the CacheUtils class which provides utility methods for cache operations such as put, get, remove, and list cache keys within the project.

classes.name: CacheUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing simplified methods for cache operations such as adding, retrieving, listing, and removing cache entries, tailored for use within the application.

methods.name: putInCache
methods.description: Stores an object in the cache with a specified key.

methods.name: getFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the cache based on the specified key.

methods.name: getCacheKeys
methods.description: Returns a list of cache keys associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: shutDownCache
methods.description: Placeholder method for shutting down the cache, currently does nothing.

methods.name: removeFromCache
methods.description: Removes a specific cache entry by key.

methods.name: removeAllFromCache
methods.description: Removes all cache entries associated with a specific MerchantStore.
